en.primary_text: 360 Logistics runs intermodal freight from rail yards to Joliet warehouses on the night shift. Local runs mean you're home daily. Automatic transmission, weekly pay. Class A, 2 years experience, age 23+.
en.headline: Home daily. Up to $360/day.
